identity.title: Prove governance regression delta on real EverRun runs

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Use two comparable real EverRun runs that can both be projected by Ailuros and run compare_governance_projections over them. Record baseline/current facts, every transition and a human evidence judgment. Do not extend the comparator unless a concrete mismatch is reproduced.
human_pressure.why_now: 8050 added the source-neutral comparator but product value is unproven until real production evidence yields trustworthy deltas.
do_not_misread: Do not compare arbitrary unrelated runs just to get non-UNCHANGED output.
Do not turn regression into an automatic release gate.
red_lines: No producer identity in comparison semantics.

machine_core.goal: Validate the existing governance regression comparator against a real baseline/current pair and repair only evidence-proven comparator defects.
red_lines: Do not add new ranks or dimensions without a reproduced incorrect transition.
Do not use producer name as comparability logic.
invariants: Both runs are independently importable and inspectable.
Pair selection is justified by same logical workload/scope or another explicit evidence-backed comparability rationale.
Unknown remains UNKNOWN rather than unchanged.
Incomparable remains INCOMPARABLE where the existing rank model cannot order facts.
Human expected judgment is written before any comparator fix.

producer.artifact: two real Ailuros ExecutionProjection objects built from raw EverRun evidence

observable_effect.assertion: The comparator produces stable dimension transitions that agree with source evidence and pre-recorded human expectations.

proofs.assertion: Real-run delta is recorded and any repaired mismatch has a focused deterministic regression test.

failure_semantics: If no defensible comparable pair exists, record insufficient evidence and keep feature semantics unchanged.
If a transition disagrees with evidence, record the mismatch before changing code.
If a dimension is policy-ambiguous rather than wrong, leave it unchanged and document the ambiguity.

steps.title: Select a defensible real pair
details: Choose baseline/current runs with explicit comparability rationale.
Record run ids and relevant source evidence before evaluating delta.

steps.title: Write expected transition matrix
details: For each existing dimension, write baseline fact, current fact and expected transition before modifying comparator code.

steps.title: Run existing comparator
details: Build both projections through production path and call compare_governance_projections.
Diff actual vs expected transition matrix.

steps.title: Repair only reproduced mismatch
details: If and only if actual transition is demonstrably wrong under existing semantics, make the smallest deterministic fix and add focused coverage.

acceptance: A real comparable pair is evaluated or insufficient evidence is explicitly recorded.
Expected transition matrix predates any fix.
Comparator output is source-neutral and deterministic.
No new dimension, score or gate is added.
Any code change has a focused regression test.

must_check: Pair comparability is explicit and not based merely on producer identity.
Expected judgments are evidence-backed and recorded before repair.
reject_if: Unrelated runs are compared without rationale.
Expected judgments are edited after seeing implementation to hide a mismatch.
New governance dimensions or generic scores are introduced.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Existing governance regression semantics validated against real evidence.
